text:
Dana López: Quick scenario: we just acquired AcmeAI and several hires are moving over. Acme had a 100% immediate vest for equity but their 401k vesting was 2 years. Can we accelerate vesting of company contributions for these transferees? Need wording for offer addendum.

Marcus Chen: Plan admin note: employer can apply a one-time vesting acceleration at its discretion but it must be documented and processed through BrightPlan. We need a signed corporate action and employee list with hire dates to apply a special vesting code.

Dana López: Who on vendor side do we need to loop in and what's turnaround? Acme HR wants this live before payroll cut next week.

BrightPlan Ops: We can process a vesting acceleration event if we receive a vendor ticket + CSV: employee_id, effective_date, vesting_pct. Typical SLA 3 business days but expedite available for emergency with "redwood-urgent" tag.

Priya Shah: For offer language, can we say: "Company will credit accelerated vesting of employer 401(k) contributions for employees transferred from AcmeAI as documented by a separate vesting addendum" ? Good enough?

Marcus Chen: That is fine. Also include how match accruals will be handled retroactively if applicable. Example: "Any employer contributions for the period prior to transfer will be credited per the addendum and subject to accelerated vesting."

Dana López: Great. Two more related Qs: 1) will accelerated vesting create X-year rule issues for forfeitures? 2) can employees take a 401(k) loan immediately after vesting acceleration?

BenefitsBot: Forfeiture rules remain governed by plan document. Accelerated vesting simply changes employee nonforfeitable balance; forfeiture timing unaffected except balance available for distribution. Loan eligibility: plan typically requires participation and minimum service. Vesting acceleration doesn't change service requirement.

Marcus Chen: Correct. If they were not yet eligible by service, they still need to meet the participation rule. If Acme had different loan rules, we cannot port those unless plan amendment done.

Riley (Payroll): Operational note: to have the accelerated vesting reflected on next statements, BrightPlan needs the CSV and payroll needs a confirmation of vested dollar amount for reporting. Send to payroll@redwood.com once vendor confirms.

Dana López: Thanks. Separately, a couple of employees asked about rolling their Acme 401k into our plan during transition vs waiting until after the vesting addendum is processed. Is there tax or timing advice?

BrightPlan Ops: Rollovers are trustee-to-trustee and can be initiated any time after they have a plan account with BrightPlan. If they roll in before an acceleration is applied, the source plan wont reflect the accelerated employer money; if you want accelerated employer contributions, process the acceleration first so it appears on the receiving account. Processing order matters.

Priya Shah: Good point. We should tell transferees: "If you want the accelerated employer credit applied, delay rollover until benefits team confirms vendor event completed."

Dana López: Final Q: some transferees have COBRA from Acme consumer plans and want to know if COBRA affects HSA eligibility when they enroll in our HDHP. Any edge cases?

BenefitsBot: COBRA coverage is treated like other coverage. If COBRA is non-HDHP, it can disqualify HSA eligibility. If they drop COBRA and enroll in Redwood HDHP effective same month, the HSA can start. If both run concurrently, payroll will block pre-tax HSA deductions.

Riley (Payroll): Operationally, we can process a provisional HSA election but will only start pre-tax payroll deductions once HR confirms COBRA termination or HDHP effective date. If payroll later finds conflict, contributions will be returned per vendor process and employee notified.

Dana López: Perfect. I'll draft the addendum language and collect the employee list. Marcus or BrightPlan Ops can you please confirm the CSV template and addendum signer details?

BrightPlan Ops: CSV template: employee_id,first_name,last_name,redwood_emp_id,effective_date,vesting_pct. Send via secure upload link—we'll DM operations contact. Addendum needs CEO sign + benefits director.

Marcus Chen: I'll coordinate signatures. Thanks everyone, this is urgent but looks workable.
